komet:cmd-alloctrace: Records where the game allocates, with call stacks, for N seconds (default 20) into a .nettrace next to the logs - for the repository's alloctool
komet:cmd-conflicts: Who patches komet's methods or komet's own code, and does the engine differ from the verified build? Rescans immediately
komet:cmd-farmesh: Distance in blocks beyond which the far LOD picture (cells of two blocks) replaces the engine's mesh (e.g. 500), 'off' or 'on' for the switch, no argument for the state. 0 = the default rule (0.35 of the view distance, at least 400)
komet:cmd-foliagerange: Range in blocks beyond which leaves and plants are not drawn (e.g. 600), 'off' for the view distance. Priced by the report's triangles-by-distance rows
komet:cmd-gui: Open the performance window (same as '.komet' with no argument, or Ctrl+F7)
komet:cmd-hitch: Hitch log: every frame over the threshold with its cause and the camera movement. 'reset' clears it
komet:cmd-hud: Toggle the on-screen performance overlay (same as F7)
komet:cmd-mods: What the other mods cost per frame and at load, and what they do (patches, registered classes). 'hud' cycles the overlay (same as Shift+F7), 'reset' clears the per-frame figures
komet:cmd-report: Everything at once: environment, settings that differ from the default, frame breakdown, hitch log. Lands as one block in client-main.log
komet:cmd-retess: Who marks chunks dirty? Counters and a sampled ranking of the sources. 'reset' clears it
komet:cmd-root: Vintage Story performance patches: status and counters
komet:cmd-safemode: Every optimisation that changes what is drawn, on or off at once - settles in seconds whether a visual glitch comes from komet
komet:cmd-shadowfoliagerange: Range in blocks beyond which leaves and plants cast no shadow (e.g. 100), 'off' for the cascade's own. The largest single GPU item there is
komet:cmd-shadownear: Size of the near shadow cascade's map in pixels (e.g. 4096), 'off' for the engine's; rebuilds the framebuffers live. No argument: show both maps
komet:cmd-shadowneardepth: Cap on the near cascade's depth in blocks (e.g. 80), 'off' for the engine's 150-200. The one number that sets how much geometry the near shadow pass draws
komet:cmd-shadownearskip: How many frames the near shadow cascade is drawn in (1 = every frame). Live, so the GPU stage line prices it within a minute
komet:cmd-stats: Show what the culling patch has been doing since the last reset
komet:cmd-stress: Automatic measurement run, drift-proof by interleaving baselines - moving or flying is fine. Optional: seconds per slice (default 2), or 'stop'
komet:cmd-toggle: Turn a single system on or off: cull, occlusion, reclaim, sunquery, glerror, prebuild, firepit, entload, entsync ... - for bisecting or A/B measuring
